note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay classifications). The Evangelical Lutheran Church is the constitutionally established church, so religion_state is official_religion with full religious freedom. Military service was compulsory for men (in March 2024 the government announced its extension to women and a longer service period). A 1985 law prohibits power production from nuclear energy and Denmark has no nuclear plants, so energy is classed as an energy mix rather than a phase-out. Immigration and healthcare classifications are gameplay judgements.
